name: Markdown Editor
description: Write and preview Markdown with live rendering, syntax highlighting, and export options.
longDescription: Markdown Editor provides a distraction-free writing environment with live preview. Supports GitHub-flavored Markdown including tables, task lists, footnotes, and math. Syntax highlighting in the editor. Export to HTML, PDF, or raw Markdown. Word count and reading time built-in. Works offline after first load.
pricingDetails: Core editor free. Pro: $2/month for cloud sync, themes, advanced exports.
